english.title: Dealer failing to notify BBC of letting of television set
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a television dealer, failed, without reasonable excuse, to give notification in the prescribed form to the BBC within 28 days of the letting of a television set on hire or hire-purchase on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF LETTING..) to **(..SPECIFY PERSON WHO IS RENTING OR HIRING..), in accordance with section 2(1)(b) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 1967
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(a) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 1967 and section14(1A) of Wireless Telegraphy Act 1949.

english.notes: Time limit on prosecutions is 6 months from the date on which evidence sufficient to justify proceedings came to the prosecutors knowledge. Proceedings shall not be so taken more than 3 years after the commission of the offence (section 5(3) Wireless Telegraphy Act 1967)
